limits: Content-free structural/timing/resource readback; no hypothesis text or semantic correctness claim.
94 separately initialized processes, each one warmup and ten measured runs; no common warm context across different fixtures. All rows retained; no retry/filter.
Not the central six-case L protocol: per-case ten-run medians/ranges are diagnostic timing evidence. No aggregate L or automatic P05/P06 qualification.

Empty was prospectively explicit. Empty terminal time is not final-text time or L; t_text remains absent. All these Empty runs actually executed the decoder, including possible early Engine energy/VAD rejection.
Engine RTF is Decoder::decode elapsed / submitted 16-kHz PCM duration, including Engine energy/VAD/preparation/native ASR; not pure ASR-kernel or Stop-to-text time.
TC snapshots prove configured compatible observed instants only; no continuous realtime scheduling, per-period budget proof, kernel causality or change to default production policy.

Wait-phase maxima are retained summaries; detailed internal wait timestamps are absent for on-budget publications. All external publication timestamps and frame/deviation equations were independently reconstructed.
time -l RSS/footprint are whole-invocation peaks, including load, warmup, ten runs and cleanup; not per-session allocation, leak proof or threshold-based resource acceptance.
Probe PIDs differ from time wrapper PIDs; serial completed invocations are bound by timestamps, exit records and unique PIDs, not a new live OS interrogation.
Publisher joins and final runtime joins are explicit; prior audio-owner quiescence uses pinned next-start handshake, not a separate exported audio-owner join counter.

Frame-complete Engine jobs and publication coverage do not add a sample-value comparison for every run. Quality/anchors, natural versus synthetic/constructed sources, mic/hotkey/recipient and resource/abort qualification remain separate.
